newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Vanke sees 15 pct net rise in '97.
newsitem.headline: China Vanke sees 15 pct net rise in '97.

text.p: Conglomerate China Vanke Co Ltd expects its net profits to rise at least 15 percent year-on-year in 1997, Vanke's chairman Wang Shi said on Tuesday.
Vanke will complete the restructuring of its business in 1997, paving the way for the earnings growth, Wang told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Vanke has been restructuring by selling stakes in some of its non-property companies in a bid to focus on real estate, a company spokeswoman said earlier this month.
Vanke, based in Shenzhen, is involved in the real estate, retail, foreign trade and industrial production sectors.
Vanke posted net profits of 151.76 million yuan for 1996 against 154.53 million in 1995 under international accounting standards.
Real estate accounted for about 52 percent of Vanke's profits last year, Vanke said in its 1996 annual report.
